summary: Iteration 35 (third-pass mobile header verification). Tested 2 viewports (Pixel 5 393x851 Chrome UA, iPhone 13 Pro 390x844 Safari UA) × 6 public pages (/inicio.html, /inscricao.html, /confirmacao, /inscricao-realizada, /pagamento-pix, /termos.html) with cache-bust ?_={ts}, wait_until=domcontentloaded + 1.5s post-load wait. ALL 8 assertions from iteration_34 now PASS on 12/12 (viewport × page) combinations. The updated <style id='__mobile_header_fix'> with `body #Topo, div#Topo` specificity + !important overrides successfully collapses the header to a compact blue bar with the IGEDUC logo centered.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile header fix now correctly uses higher-specificity selectors (`body #Topo`, `div#Topo`) with !important — prior iteration failed because base `#Topo{height:400px!important}` and `#Logo{float:left;width:200px}` needed matching specificity to override.
The centered inline-block approach on #Logo h1 a with text-align:center on #Logo works robustly across both Chrome-Android and Safari-iOS UAs.
VLibras and menu suppression via multiple attribute-selectors is comprehensive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile header on all 6 public pages is now fully compliant with the compact-header spec (single centered logo on blue background, height ~65-75px, no menu / no Área do Candidato / no VLibras / no horizontal overflow). No further mobile-header regressions observed. Scope was strictly limited to header — confirmacao 2-col stacking and 38px button heights were NOT re-tested per instructions.
